description: A warm, youthful masculine voice with a charismatic, adventurous, and confident personality. Use expressive, natural delivery with clear articulation and a relaxed, engaging rhythm. Give the character a sense of courage and determination, with a friendly warmth and a subtle hint of humor. The voice should feel approachable yet strong, balancing youthful enthusiasm with a touch of maturity. Inspired by the broad vocal qualities of a charming adventure-game protagonist, not an exact imitation of any specific character or voice actor.

en.text: Leila had only one choice: cross the bridge before sunset. The winds were growing stronger, and the ground was trembling beneath her feet. But she refused to turn back.

ar.text: لم يكن أمام ليلى سوى خيار واحد: عبور الجسر قبل غروب الشمس. الرياح تزداد قوة، والأرض تهتز تحت قدميها، لكنها لم تتراجع، فقد كان صديقها ينتظرها في الجهة الأخرى
